lessons: The arnona constants were the textbook 'banded amount written flat' defect and were wrong in BOTH value and UNIT: the skill carried Tel Aviv at 55.80 per sqm bi-monthly, while the city's own 2026 tzav arnona publishes tariffs per sqm PER YEAR, from 46.64 to 139.60 across 5 zones and 6 residential building types. 55.80 appears nowhere in the order. The bundled script compounded it by multiplying the bi-monthly figure by 6. Removed the constants rather than correcting them, because no single scalar per city can be right.

The Bituach Leumi / health tax rates were a one-row extract of a 17-row official table. The standard 1.04% / 7.00% row is correct, but under-18 employees and working pensioners are ZERO-rated, so a generated payroll sheet over-deducted their entire employee contribution. Added the full table in both languages.

CARRY: the self-employed BL rates in references/israeli-tax-rates.md (4.47% reduced / 12.83% full) were NOT verified this cycle; only the employee-side table was pulled from btl.gov.il. Verify against the self-employed rates page next cycle.
